name: Adversity Scroller
description: Scroll-driven showcase where giant words act as clip-paths over photos, sliding, scaling and rotating across the screen as you scroll, interleaved with gradient-headed prose blocks.
contents: Eight sections of oversized SVG clip-path text revealing background images or video
Prose block with gradient heading and body text after each section
behavior: Each word is a clipPath over a photo and is animated by scrubbed ScrollTrigger timelines
Per-section effects: sliding, skew, scale, rotation, hue and brightness shifts, drop shadow
One section swaps its image with a brightness fade as scroll progresses
Root fades in once images have loaded

props.name: sections
props.default: 8 built-in section configs with animation builders

props.name: fontUrl
props.default: Google Fonts stylesheet URL for the display fonts

editableByProps: Words shown in each section, images, video, prose texts and optional heading
Background, text and heading gradient colors
Fonts, font faces, text scale, section heights and gaps
Smooth scroll on or off, lerp and scrub

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the animation of a section
needsCodeEdit.where: build function of each entry in the SECTIONS constant

needsCodeEdit.change: Add or remove sections or change their layout

needsCodeEdit.where: onUpdate callback in the Momoso section build function

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis when smoothScroll is true, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Appends the font stylesheet link to document.head and does not remove it on unmount
Root starts at opacity 0 and fades in after images load
Section animations are tied to the built-in section order and image assignment order
Includes vertical gaps between sections for scroll range
